architecture.change_boundary: write_aggregate_sheet membership ref and existing materialized_row_sources_ref_matches verifier only
failure_modes: new compact ref fails to detect normalized membership tampering
old embedded ref stops requiring exact embedded-row equality
contributor/plugin receipt refs accidentally lose their embedded rows
proof: new compact refs validate count and sha256 against stored relation rows
stored relation mutation invalidates compact refs
old refs still validate and reject embedded-row mutation
contributor materialization still emits embedded rows
architecture.proportionality: Reuse the existing ref kind, op_id, row_count, sha256, normalized table, and verifier. Add no schema, resolver, reference protocol, or generic streaming layer.

environment: canonical lock-identical Python environment, cleared environment, network namespace disabled, temporary project bundles
shape: One aggregate output row and one aggregate_source membership per source row. Each stored receipt uses the actual Receipt and ReceiptStore schema and includes the actual materialized_rows output plus pinned membership evidence.
interpretation: The embedded membership rows are a material majority of this aggregate receipt shape and are much larger than the authoritative normalized relation payload. The compact receipt still contains the existing materialized_rows output, so this change does not claim to bound all aggregate metadata.
representation_refinement: Final compact refs add storage=normalized_relation_v1 so missing rows is explicit and unmarked rowless legacy refs remain invalid. The marker adds 35 bytes to compact JSON; it does not materially change the measured reductions. Count/hash validates relation consistency, not coordinated receipt mutation.
